stop_or_escalation_conditions: Production data could be corrupted or mutated unexpectedly.
A P0/P1 security, tenant-isolation or data-integrity defect is discovered.
The tested build cannot be identified reliably.
The test harness cannot prove the RallyHub application rendered for a required browser test.
continue_after_failure_rule: Continue independent tests where safe and record all failures; do not abandon a population audit because one item fails.

publish_verification_plan.persistence_check: Confirm exact tested edits exist in persisted source/current commit/checkpoint.
publish_verification_plan.production_fingerprint: After publish, verify live asset hash/release marker matches the intended release candidate.
